Name: Steven Haddock
Question: What is the reason for using an alphabet in most languages instead of a syllabary or other writing system?
Answer: Syllabaries are great if your language has a limited number of syllables, like Japanese or Inuktitut. Japanese has about a hundred, and Inuktitut has about forty, so it’s not difficult to come up with a written system to cover all cases, particularly when Inuktitut’s syllabary has a system to it. But if your language allows pretty much an unlimited number of syllables, it’s nearly impossible to have either a systemic or arbitrary set of symbols for them. English, for example, uses 15,000 different distinct syllables, and can possibly use over 100,000. Also, if you try to have a syllabary, it’s pretty much going to be unique to your language. If you have an alphabet, it’s fairly easy to adjust it to your language to make it fit, which means several alphabets, like the Latin and Cyrillic alphabets, can be adapted across several languages, even if they’re unrelated. The Latin alphabet, used for the unrelated languages English and Spanish And again, for the two unrelated languages English and Turkish And, once again, for the two unrelated languages English and Vietnamese. The Cyrillic alphabet, used for the unrelated language Mongolian. Mongolian switched to Cyrillic about 90 years ago to replace their own, but difficult to use, alphabet.

Name: Steven Haddock
Question: How do donations turn into votes? You cannot pay voters to vote for you.
Answer: Hi! I’m Joanie Noname, a candidate for the U.S. Senate. Well, I’m making a primary run against a well known local businessman and the former mayor of the state’s largest city, and whoever wins that primary goes up against the incumbent Senator who represents the other party. And you’ve never heard of me. And it’s “Noh-naym” not “No-na-mee”. Well, I think I would make a terrific candidate. I actually went to West Point and finished fourth in my class, and served as a logistics officer in Iraq during my four year hitch. After that, I got a master’s degree in education and taught school before making principal and deciding to get into the U.S. foreign service where I worked my way up to the Ambassador to Paraguay. Did I mention I speak fluent Spanish? After coming back and running the state department of education and moving the state up from 30th to 15th in the U.S. rankings in four years, I ran for the state senate and eventually became the majority whip. As such, a lot of people in the party know who I am and that I have the ability to get things done. Frankly, the businessman and the mayor are at odds with the party because they keep sucking up to businesspeople who support the other party and the mayor actually cut programs as an “austerity measure”. But you’ve heard of them. You haven’t heard of me. And the only way I’m going to win this primary and the senate race is if people learn who I am . Frankly, it’s going to be an ugly primary fight but the businessman has plenty of money for his own campaign and the mayor has lots of rich donors to support his run. We’re trying to put together a grass roots campaign starting with people who know me well who may be able to chip in a few bucks so we can do more fundraising. Because despite my qualifications in politics, there’s no way I’m going to win if no-one in my own party knows who the hell I am. I also expect the incumbent, who everyone knows, to fight dirty and avoid the issues. Even if I lose, it’s still going to cost a lot of money, and I just don’t have it. In 2022, the 33 Senate races saw a total of $3.1 billion in total spending, or about $100 million each. And this is a small state, but it doesn’t matter because all Senate seats count the same. And if I don’t raise money, the press will think I’m not really serious about winning. Honestly, six years ago, we lost this seat 51–49 so it’s clearly winnable for our side. If I don’t raise serious money, they will think I’m setting myself up to become governor or a later run for congress instead. And, yes, you can’t pay voters to vote for you. However, voters will vote for someone they dislike long before they will vote for someone they’ve never heard of.

Name: Steven Haddock
Question: How do I request a hearing in court?
Answer: Well, that’s not how this works. That’s not how any of this works. First, you have to start a “proceeding”. Proceedings come in two flavours - “claims” and “applications”. Claims are for ordinary routine run of the mill legal disputes like automobile accidents and breach of contract. “Applications” are generally for disputes that are tightly constrained by statutory requirements, like enforcing a judgement from another jurisdiction. If you don’t know which one applies to your situation, go get a lawyer. Now, there are two types of hearings in general - “motions” and “trials”. In order to get a trial, you have to go through a series of procedures outlined in “rules” that apply in your jurisdiction. Until you complete all those steps, you can’t have a trial. Once you’ve completed all the steps, you will be put on a list and they will call you, probably to show up in court, to set a trial date. “Motions” are generally to settle things that have to be determined before trial. This can include emergency actions like stopping a contractor from coming onto your property to work on your neighbour’s house. It can also include a hearing that will eliminate the need for a trial. In order to get a “motion date”, you have to follow “local rules” which are unique to every courthouse. For example, at the Superior Court here in Toronto, for a date to hear an application (which is a motion, not a trial, although the court can convert your application to a claim and a trial) you have to show up at a “case conference” with the other side to discuss what steps have to be taken before the motion date and pick a date after they’ve all been allowed to complete. Again, if it’s an emergency (i.e. your husband is an irreversible coma and his lawyer got an order to keep you from pulling the plug even though you’ve made arrangements to donate their organs - no that happened) there is a way to get a judge but short of that you wait your turn. What you can never, ever do is just walk into a courthouse and ask to see a judge. That’s a big “no”. If you carry on, they have security guards and nearby police who will remove you and, if necessary, arrest you.

Name: Steven Haddock
Question: How do freshwater lakes get their water? Are there any lakes that do not drain into another body of water?
Answer: Freshwater lakes are essentially large rainwater reservoirs - big natural holes in the ground that collect water that flow into them. In addition to the body of the lake, every lake has a “watershed”, a group of rivers, creeks and streams that collect the water that falls within a certain area and eventually wind up in the lake. In addition to getting water from Lake Erie over Niagara Falls, Lake Ontario, the “lowest” of the five Great Lakes, also is fed by streams and rivers from both Ontario and New York before draining through the St. Lawrence River. In its early history about 12,000 years ago, Lake Ontario was much bigger as there was a glacier that blocked its water flow, so the water went through what’s now the Hudson River Valley. Note Lake Ontario is fed by other lakes, like New York’s Finger Lakes and Ontario’s Rice Lake.

Name: Steven Haddock
Question: Is it possible for a city to place a lien on your property?
Answer: Absolutely, and here’s the thing - they don’t even have to do any paperwork. Under the laws in most jurisdictions, any unpaid tax immediately attaches to the property on the tax roll and has the highest priority - it even outranks a mortgage. If you buy a property with unpaid taxes, you’re not personally liable for those back taxes, but the lien remains on the property which means it passes to anyone who is dumb enough to buy it without checking. If you pay the normal taxes, they’re applied to the back taxes first. When you buy a house, one of your lawyer’s jobs is to check the city’s tax rolls to see if there are any outstanding taxes. If there are, they will contact the seller and tell them those taxes will be paid to the city on closing and that they won’t be receiving that money. This is different from a tax sale. If the arrears are very large, the municipality is entitled to sell your property to collect those taxes, but they have to give notice to anyone else with an interest in the property, which would include any lender who has a mortgage. If your mortgage company finds out you have arrears, they have the option of paying them off and adding those arrears to your mortgage.
